gripeverde.field_guide.title: Survivor's Field Manual
gripeverde.field_guide.subtitle: CEDA DISPATCH · UNCENSORED COPY
gripeverde.field_guide.body.infection: The Green Flu accelerates rabies. Ghouls are alive: blue eyes, extreme adrenaline, and mutations.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.pins: PIN attacks remove your control. A teammate must free you; the trapped alert sounds for the whole crew. Never explore alone: a pinned survivor cannot escape.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.downed: At 0 hearts you enter the downed state. An ally must hold right click for 5 seconds without taking damage to revive you.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.dead: If your incapacity bar reaches 0, you die and spectate without losing your inventory. Your body remains where you died; only a defibrillator found in loot can revive you.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.supplies: Ammunition and supplies may dwindle over time. Count every round and search each safe room.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.difficulty: Available: Easy, Normal, Advanced, and Expert; then INSURGENCY I–V and INFERNUM I–V. BACKBREAKING I–X, DOOMSDAY I–X, and ARMAGEDDON I–X are WIP. Higher ranks raise general infected stats and add challenges and global events.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.requirements: Seeing an action in chat does not mean you can repeat it. Check its requirements first; some depend on your race, evolution, items, or completed missions.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.regroup: The white rally marker tracks allies beyond 3,000 blocks, even across unloaded chunks. Use it to find your crew again.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.races: Survivors may be Human, Shark, Cyborg, or one of 300+ races. Evolve from V1 through V4+ by completing tasks or missions tied to your race's rarity.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.rarities: Rarity order: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Ultra Rare, Legendary, Obsainan, Mythic, Godly, Eternal, Fabled. The same scale classifies artifacts and items.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.mutation_ori: Local habits, genetics, and a person's health shape Ghoul mutations. They remain alive and driven by extreme adrenaline; never assume one mutation behaves like another.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.ceda_coverup: In this server's 1800 timeline, authorities called the outbreak a common flu to prevent panic. The Green Flu is a living rabies-and-influenza mutation; it does not raise corpses.
gripeverde.options.sound.ui_slider.toolt: Adjust menu clicks, hovers and notifications.
gripeverde.options.sound.test_button.too: Preview this interface sound at the current SFX level. The status line shows the mod levels; if the preview is silent, check the SFX control and Minecraft's master volume.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.rescue_alert: A global trapped alert means a teammate is PINNED. They cannot free themselves: reach them and break the PIN.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.rescue_downe: At 0 hearts, stay beside the downed survivor. Hold right click for 5 seconds without taking damage to revive them.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.rescue_dead: If a teammate's incapacity bar reaches 0, they die and spectate without losing their inventory. Their body remains at the death site; only a defibrillator found in loot can revive them.
gripeverde.options.sound.music_slider.to: The menu music level is multiplied by Minecraft's Music category volume. Raise that category too if the music is silent.
gripeverde.options.sound.ambience_slider: The ambience level is multiplied by Minecraft's Ambient/Environment category volume. Raise that category too if the loops are silent.
